# 1985–1995: Systems, Souls, and the Dirtiest Jobs

The decade from 1985 to 1995 was the decade when Bob's career shifted from technical to managerial, from the immediate satisfactions of engineering to the more diffuse satisfactions of leadership. The transition was not planned; it emerged from the confluence of his skills, his opportunities, and the needs of the organizations he served. But the transition was real, and its effects would persist for the rest of his working life.
